testcase.name: Given BIOMETRIC_ERROR_NONE_ENROLLED when canAuthenticate then returns NoneEnrolled()

Given ERROR_LOCKOUT_PERMANENT when onAuthenticationError then calls onPermanentLockout()
Given BIOMETRIC_ERROR_NO_HARDWARE when canAuthenticate then returns NoHardware()
Given ERROR_LOCKOUT when onAuthenticationError then calls onPermanentLockout()
Given ERROR_NEGATIVE_BUTTON when onAuthenticationError then calls onFallbackToPin()
Given ERROR_USER_CANCELED when onAuthenticationError then calls onFallbackToPin()
Given BIOMETRIC_ERROR_SECURITY_UPDATE_REQUIRED when canAuthenticate then returns SecurityUpdateRequired()
Given successful auth when onAuthenticationSucceeded then calls onSuccess()
Given BIOMETRIC_SUCCESS when canAuthenticate then returns Available()
